headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 7, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies with a 15-1 win, led by Noah Cameron's strong performance. Tyler Tolbert had a standout game at the plate with 5 hits, including a home run and 2 RBI. In other news, the New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays behind Cam Schlittler's 8.0 innings of work, and the New York Mets edged out the Atlanta Braves 7-6 in a thrilling matchup.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with Konnor Griffin being placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left ring finger sagittal back injury. Other notable injuries include David Hamilton's strained left hamstring and Brandon Lockridge's right knee laceration and contusion. The Milwaukee Brewers' Brandon Woodruff has also been placed on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the New York Mets acquiring Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers and the Houston Astros trading Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals. The Minnesota Twins also acquired Woo-Suk Go from the Detroit Tigers, and the Cleveland Guardians picked up Ryan Degges from the Philadelphia Phillies.

top_news.title: **Royals Rout Phillies 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, winning 15-1 behind a strong performance from Noah Cameron, who earned the win with 5.0 IP, 7 K, and 1 ER. Tyler Tolbert led the Royals' offense with 5 hits, including a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Rays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, led by a dominant performance from Cam Schlittler, who pitched 8.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and 1 earned run. José Caballero had a standout game at the plate, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 4 runs.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall Short in Thrilling 11-12 Loss to Nationals**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals edged out the Houston Astros 11-12 in a high-scoring matchup. CJ Abrams led the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 7-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a hard-fought win over the Atlanta Braves, outlasting their opponents 7-6. Matt Olson led the Braves' offense with a standout performance, recording 2 hits and 2 home runs.

top_news.title: **Brewers Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a hard-fought 4-3 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Christian Yelich and Jake Bauers contributing key hits for the Brewers. Jacob Misiorowski earned the win for the Brewers.

top_news.title: **Pirates Place Griffin on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates shortstop Konnor Griffin has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left ring finger sagittal back injury. The move is retroactive to July 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
